name: p1-seeded-lock-server-source
cmd: set -euo pipefail; ROOT=$PWD; OUT=$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR; bun install --frozen-lockfile > "$OUT/install.log" 2>&1; bun scripts/gen-lean-library.ts > "$OUT/library-gen.log" 2>&1; bunx tsc -p research/bapa/tsconfig.candidate-seed.json > "$OUT/types.log" 2>&1; bun test research/bapa/candidate-seed.test.ts research/bapa/candidate-seed-public.test.ts research/bapa/proof-worker.test.ts > "$OUT/tests.log" 2>&1; printf '%s\n' 'test(bapa): seed two p1 searches from retained historical families' > "$OUT/seed-message.txt"; printf '%s\n' 'test(bapa): recheck seeded lock server source proof in Lean' > "$OUT/commit-message.txt"; bunx @commitlint/cli --config research/egraph/historical/commitlint.config.cjs < "$OUT/seed-message.txt" > "$OUT/seed-commitlint.log" 2>&1; bunx @commitlint/cli --config research/egraph/historical/commitlint.config.cjs < "$OUT/commit-message.txt" > "$OUT/commitlint.log" 2>&1; bun research/bapa/proof-emit.ts --capture p1-seeded/p1-seeded-lock_server.files/lock_server/closure --sha256 74134f5c9a15808ef5521f93e42226afc1ff96397f8404daf7d9a7978411e0df --projection alpha --out "$OUT/project" > "$OUT/emission.log" 2>&1; cd "$OUT/project"; lake build > "$OUT/lean.log" 2>&1; lake env lean BapaProof.lean >> "$OUT/lean.log" 2>&1; bun "$ROOT/scripts/lean-gate/gate.ts" "$OUT/lean.log" BapaProof.lean > "$OUT/axioms.log" 2>&1; rm -rf "$OUT/project/.lake"
